description:
Read native instruments through a saved broker connection. Use search for prediction-market contracts/details/rules and options for a bounded option chain. Preserve native IDs and the saved account mode for subsequent quotes and trades.

Set "action" to choose the operation. Only send the fields listed for that action.

## action="search": Find broker markets
No other fields required.
Read-only native market/contract discovery through the signed-in user's saved broker connection. Use this before web search for contracts available on a connected prediction exchange such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Pass query to search, marketId to read one contract and its settlement rules, or eventId to list the child contracts of a native event; omit these selectors to browse. An event groups contracts and is not itself tradable: choose an exact returned child market identifier and outcome before quotes or approval. Results are bounded, not a complete venue inventory. Keep exact native identifiers and outcome mappings for get_broker_quotes and place_trade. The saved connection selects demo or live; demo availability/prices are not live forecasts. Never invent tickers or pass raw credentials.

## action="options": Get broker option chain
Required fields: underlyingSymbol.
Read-only: fetches option chain data from the signed-in user's saved broker connection. Always narrow large requests with expiration or expirationStart/expirationEnd, strikeMin/strikeMax, right, detailLevel, limit, or page. If the response is too large, retry using the provided retryWith suggestions. Never pass raw credentials.

action.description: Which operation to run: "search", "options". See the tool description for each one.

underlyingSymbol.description: Used with action="options". Required for action="options".
